title: Zesty Mexican Pistachio Tacos
description: A tangy, pillowy taco that blends pistachio paste with a spicy turkey filling and bright lime for a festive Whole30-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: corn tortillas
ingredients.notes: whole wheat or corn, depending on preference

instructions: Place the ground turkey in the pressure cooker and brown it over medium heat with the olive oil, stirring until cooked through.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper, then close the lid and cook on high pressure for 10 minutes.
While the filling cooks, heat the corn tortillas on a dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Release the pressure, fluff the turkey mixture with a fork, and stir in the pistachio paste and lime juice until well combined.
Spoon the hot filling onto the warmed tortillas, garnishing each taco with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, optionally adding slices of avocado on top if desired.
Enjoy the zesty, creamy pistachio tacos as a festive Whole30-friendly meal.
